column1: # Stage S7 X7a — the S7 switch: every consumer of the streaming and mission editing crates imports them directly, and the map engine's `streaming::{scheduler, buffers}` and `editing` re-export shims go. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# One module prefix of the S7 shim ledger per block, as a `crate::` row scoped to the map engine
# and a `map_engine::` row scoped to the single-page app, the one outside consumer. The shims were
# aliases, so the rows carry the alias: `editing::commands` is `mission_editing_commands::document_text`,
# spellings without a trailing segment (`map_engine::editing`) and Markdown are rewritten by hand.
